_comment: Interaction scenarios for verify/pixel-diff.mjs --states on the demo site (examples/demo). Every scenario is produced with the same steps on both sides, then a full-page screenshot is compared. Actions: {click|hover: selector}, {type: selector, text: ...}, {press: key}, {mouse: [x, y]}, {evaluate: js}, {wait: ms}, {waitFor: selector}. park: [x, y] moves the mouse to a neutral point after the actions so no hover transition makes the image random; scenarios that hover on purpose leave park out. Selectors with :visible pick the visible one of several controls with the same name (the header renders search and theme buttons once for wide and once for narrow views). If a selector is missing on one side, the scenario fails there (no silent skipping). pages is a regular expression on the page path, widths and themes restrict to the listed values. Selectors rely on ids, ARIA and data attributes and structure; where they use a class (prose) or a class substring it has to match on both sides, because the reference and Pholio carry different classes. Labels are the English UI strings of the demo.

states.name: search-open-results
states.description: Search dialog open, query 'archive', result list loaded.

states.name: sidebar-collapsed
states.intentional: Intentional difference from the reference (Luka's decision, 2026-09-13): with the sidebar collapsed, content and table of contents sit as one centred group instead of the page column growing to the left edge.
states.description: Sidebar collapsed, mouse far away from the hover zone.

states.name: sidebar-collapsed-hovered
states.intentional: Intentional difference from the reference (Luka's decision, 2026-09-13): with the sidebar collapsed, content and table of contents sit as one centred group instead of the page column growing to the left edge.
states.description: Sidebar collapsed and shown again through the 4 px hover zone at the left edge (data-hovered=true). The zone is the first child of [data-sidebar-placeholder] and only active in the collapsed state.

states.name: sidebar-collapsed-expanded
states.description: Sidebar collapsed and expanded again through the same trigger.

states.name: sidebar-collapsed-search-open

states.description: Sidebar collapsed, then the search dialog opened.

states.name: sidebar-collapsed-theme-switched

states.description: Sidebar collapsed, then the theme switched.

states.name: toc-popover-open
states.description: Collapsible table of contents of the narrow view opened.

states.name: section-switcher-open
states.description: Section switcher in the sidebar head opened. The trigger carries lg:hidden and is only visible below 1024 px; there the sidebar lives in the drawer, which is therefore opened first.

states.name: theme-switched
states.description: Theme switch of the header pressed once; the page is then in the other theme.

states.name: theme-switched-drawer
states.description: Theme switch of the narrow view. Below 768 px it sits only in the drawer footer, which is therefore opened first.

states.name: theme-switched-start-page
states.description: Theme switch of the start page in the narrow view. Below 768 px it sits in the mobile menu, which is therefore opened first.

states.name: toc-active-after-scroll
states.description: Scrolled to the third heading, the matching table of contents entry is active.
